title: Schools Oppose FCC Plan to End Broadband Fund
excerpt: Educational institutions across the United States are protesting an FCC proposal to eliminate a key broadband funding program.
body_html:
Schools and libraries throughout the United States are raising objections to an FCC proposal that could terminate a multi-billion-dollar broadband program. The initiative provides essential internet connectivity to children and educational facilities.

The controversy centers on comments from the FCC chair, who has threatened the E-Rate fund while attributing excessive screen time among children to schools. In response, educational groups are urging the commission to abandon the plan to scrap the funding program, warning that the move would disconnect students from necessary digital resources.
